premise: Maya gets three guesses what's in the supply pod — chocolate? new socks? — and it's a seedling, the first living green thing she's seen in months.
inspiration: Pandora's box (Greek myth), turned: the box is full of good things, and the best one comes out last.
lesson: The best surprises are the ones that grow.

en-US.title: Three Guesses
en-US.text: {sfx:thud} Thump! A {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod set down on the landing pad. {woman:enter} Maya came bounding over {woman:go to supply-pod} to see. {woman:face happy} [playfully] The label said only: MAYA. GUESS! {woman:says} [excited] “Guess one: chocolate!” {supply-pod:wobble} {supply-pod:live hold} Its side panels slid open. Crates of food, and tools, and spare parts. But no chocolate. {woman:face sad} {woman:says} “Guess two: new socks?” {supply-pod:shake 0.4} Plenty of socks. Not quite it. {woman:says} [curious] “Guess three…” {woman:pulse} At the very back sat a little white pod with a clear dome on top. Inside, in dark soil, was a {seedling:enter} seedling. [short pause] {woman:face surprised} [gasps] Maya hadn't seen anything green and growing for months. {seedling:live} The seedling stretched, and opened its brand-new leaf. {woman:face happy} {woman:live} [happily] Maya waved at it. It was better than chocolate. {seedling:sparkle}

es-ES.title: Tres adivinanzas
es-ES.text: {sfx:thud} ¡Pum! Una {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga se posó en la plataforma de aterrizaje. {woman:enter} Maya llegó dando saltos {woman:go to supply-pod} para verla. {woman:face happy} [playfully] La etiqueta solo decía: MAYA. ¡ADIVINA! {woman:says} [excited] «Primera adivinanza: ¡chocolate!» {supply-pod:wobble} {supply-pod:live hold} Sus paneles laterales se abrieron. Cajas de comida, herramientas y piezas de repuesto. Pero ni rastro de chocolate. {woman:face sad} {woman:says} «Segunda: ¿calcetines nuevos?» {supply-pod:shake 0.4} Había muchos. Pero no era eso. {woman:says} [curious] «Tercera…» {woman:pulse} Al fondo del todo había una pequeña cápsula blanca con una cúpula transparente. Dentro, en tierra oscura, había un {seedling:enter} brote. [short pause] {woman:face surprised} [gasps] Maya llevaba meses sin ver nada verde que creciera. {seedling:live} El brote se estiró y abrió su hojita nueva. {woman:face happy} {woman:live} [happily] Maya lo saludó con la mano. Era mejor que el chocolate. {seedling:sparkle}
